data.name: Khayzar

data.long_meaning: Khayzar is derived from the Arabic word 'Khazr', which means 'to be generous'. The name Khayzar carries the meaning “Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Khayzar usually hope their child will grow to embody generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies generosity and kindness.
data.etymology: Khayzar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khayzar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: خيزر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من خير، بمعنى الشخص الذي يأتي بالخير وينشره
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم خيزر مشتق من جذر خ-ي-ر، ويعني الشخص الذي يأتي بالخير وينشره، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَيُخْرِجُ الْخَيْرَ وَيَقْبَضُ' (الإسراء: 31)، ويعتبر اسم خيزر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني إيجابية وروحانية، حيث يرمز إلى نشر الخير والسلام في المجتمع

in_urdu.name: خیزر
in_urdu.meaning: خیر کا لانے والا، خیر کو پھیلانے والا، نیکی کا باعث
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام خیزر عربی جڑ خ-ی-ر سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خیر کا لانے والا یا نیکی کا باعث۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر مقبول ہے، جہاں اس کا تلفظ 'خیزر' کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس نام کا روحانی مطلب ہے کسی کے آس پاس کے لوگوں میں خیر و نیکی کو پھیلانا

in_hindi.name: ख़यज़र
in_hindi.meaning: ख़ैर लाने वाला, ख़ैर फैलाने वाला, नेक होने का कारण
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम ख़यज़र अरबी जड़ ख-य-र से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है ख़ैर लाने वाला या नेक होने का कारण। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में विशेष रूप से लोकप्रिय है, जहां इसका उच्चारण 'ख़यज़र' किया जाता है। इस नाम का आध्यात्मिक अर्थ है अपने आसपास के लोगों में ख़ैर और नेकी को फैलाना

in_pashto.name: خېزر
in_pashto.meaning: د خير راوړونکی، د خير خپرونکی، د نیکۍ سبب
in_pashto.long_meaning: د خېزر نوم د عربي ريښې خ-ي-ر څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې د خير راوړونکی يا د نیکۍ سبب دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دوديزې کې ډېر مشهور دی، چيرته چې د 'خېزر' په توګه تلفظ کيږي. د دې نوم روحاني معنی دا ده چې په خپل چاپیریال کې خير او نیکي خپروي

in_english.name: Khayzar
in_english.meaning: Bringer of good, doer of good deeds, charitable person
in_english.long_meaning: The name Khayzar originates from the Arabic root 'kh-y-r', meaning 'good' or 'charity'. In Islamic tradition, Khayzar signifies a person who brings goodness and spreads it within their community. The name is associated with positive qualities such as generosity, kindness, and piety. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the aspiration to embody virtues and contribute positively to society

data.cultural_impact: The name Khayzar may be considered a noble and prestigious one in Islamic cultures, as generosity is a highly valued virtue in the Islamic faith. Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charity." (Sahih Muslim). Therefore, the name Khayzar serves as a constant reminder for its bearer to strive towards embodying the virtues of kindness and generosity to others.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Khayzar holds significant importance as it represents a connection to the divine attribute of generosity. In Islamic spirituality, it is believed that all blessings come from Allah, and that we are merely stewards of these blessings. The name Khayzar serves as a reminder to its bearer to be a conduit of Allah's blessings to others and to strive towards being generous in all aspects of life, including time, resources, and kindness. It is also a reminder of the importance of recognizing and being grateful for Allah's blessings and seeking His pleasure in all we do. Ultimately, the name Khayzar is a reminder of the role of generosity in cultivating a strong and meaningful connection with Allah and others.
